sources.title: kuka_lbr_iiwa_support - ROS Wiki
sources.snippet: ROS-Industrial support for the KUKA LBR IIWA (and variants). This package contains configuration data, 3D models and launch files for KUKA LBR IIWA manipulators. This currently includes the base model. Joint limits and max joint velocities are based on the information in the KUKA data sheets online.

sources.title: KUKA iiwa Robot Model | tum-i6/VTPRL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The KUKA iiwa (intelligent industrial work assistant) is a 7 degree-of-freedom (DOF) robot arm designed for collaborative applications. In the VTPRL system, this robot model serves as the primary manipulator for reinforcement learning tasks, providing a realistic simulation environment for training robotic manipulation policies.
